collection_method: Elsevier Scopus Search API (ISSN 0144-8617, PUBYEAR>2024, sort=-coverDate, paged start=0..300, X-ELS-APIKey auth) for discovery; Crossref API (api.crossref.org/works) for author/volume/article-number/date metadata (Elsevier Abstract Retrieval / Article Retrieval APIs returned AUTHORIZATION_ERROR/AUTHENTICATION_ERROR for abstract/full-text under this key's entitlement). PubMed E-utilities ESearch/ESummary cross-checked with datetype=pdat reldate=60 and datetype=edat reldate=14 (both returned 0 items not already in state/seen_articles.json). WebSearch used as supplementary check for focus keywords (okara, soybean protein isolate, paper coating) - no additional unseen eligible articles found. No abstract text was obtainable for any of the 13 collected articles via Elsevier, PubMed, Crossref, Semantic Scholar, or Unpaywall (all are very recent Articles in Press, formal issue date 2026-10, not yet indexed with abstracts anywhere accessible).
